title: EHR System Connect Android App (In-Development)
summary: Native Android companion app bridging mobile clinicians with the centralized EHR Healthcare Web System for real-time bedside charting.
desc: Currently in active development, this native Android mobile application establishes a high-security mobile companion to the EHR Healthcare Web System. Engineered with Jetpack Compose and offline-first Room database synchronization, allowing healthcare providers to access patient vitals, review orders, and update clinical documentation directly from point-of-care.
accomplishments: Engineered native Android architecture using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, connecting directly via secure WebSocket and REST gateways to the EHR Web platform.
Designed offline-first local caching using Room database with automatic conflict resolution upon reconnection.
Implemented biometric hardware authentication (Fingerprint / Face Unlock) enforcing strict patient data access controls.
Integrated low-latency push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for urgent physician alerts and critical lab updates.
testimonial: Active mobile companion client engineered for bedside clinical productivity and continuous EHR system synchronization.
author: Clinical Engineering Architecture

title: EHR Healthcare Workflow Management System
summary: Built robust, secure electronic health record operations and structured data handling to eliminate manual latencies for clinical documentation.
desc: A secure clinical operations platform designed to eliminate manual data entry latency for hospital and clinical staff. Orchestrates complex multi-provider workflows, patient intake schemas, and medical record interoperability, serving as the central hub for companion mobile clients.
accomplishments: Eliminated manual latencies for clinical documentation by engineering structured data entry pipelines and automated schema validation.
Handled complex healthcare workflows integrating with industry platform frameworks like PaceHR and Gehrimed.
Architected central backend APIs and real-time state synchronization powering both web portals and the EHR System Connect Android application.
Implemented strict access control and real-time state synchronization for patient scheduling, prescriptions, and lab records.
testimonial: The streamlined record management workflows significantly curtailed doctor intake administrative delays while maintaining structural precision.
author: Clinical Operations Lead

title: Unofficial Mech (Google Play Production App)
summary: Independently owned the entire product lifecycle from design to deployment, scaling an on-demand student resource application on the Google Play Store.
desc: A production-grade native Android mobile application serving thousands of engineering students. Designed from scratch, published on the Google Play Store, and continuously maintained with zero crash-rate regressions.
accomplishments: Independently owned the entire product lifecycle from initial Figma UX conceptualization to Google Play Store production deployment.
Architected using Kotlin, Java, and Jetpack Compose under MVVM Architecture for maintainable, reactive state flows.
Integrated Google AI Studio SDK (AI) for context-aware academic assistance and study summarization.
Implemented Google Play Billing for tiered subscriptions and monitored runtime performance with Android Vitals and Firebase Crashlytics.
testimonial: A responsive, feature-packed native Android utility that has transformed how engineering students collaborate and access resources daily.
author: Engineering Student Community
